name: Dynamic SDF Ray Marching with Adaptive Step Skipping
definition: A GPU-based ray marching technique for Signed Distance Fields (SDFs) that advances ray origins by predicted distances, skips empty space using an octree, handles floor reflections, and tracks shadow visibility metrics for soft shadows.
summary: Dynamic SDF Ray Marching with Adaptive Step Skipping is a GPU technique that predicts step sizes from previous distances and skips empty space via an octree to optimize volume rendering.
